# Controlled Vocabulary

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A curated collection of concepts, labels, definitions, and relations with other concepts.

**Also known as:** Vocabulary

## Scope note

Establishes shared understanding of what certain words and phrases mean in a specific context.

## Editorial note

_An open question about this term, not part of its definition._

In "Domain-Driven Design", Eric Evans calls this "Ubiquitous Language" when designing a domain model for software architecture that provides common knowledge between people (domain experts and developers) and systems (apps, services, and agents) about what objects know and do.
